# Native fixture source review map (#1640)

Source review must cover the ENTIRE cumulative implementation against ADR-002 and SPEC-002 FI-1..FI-7, including native provisioning, actor loader/bridge, W actual lifecycle driver, live M/K read-only clients, ordinary R theft/denial actors, source/private channel bindings, positive/partial regression sources, F7 error capture and unchanged original gates.

This map adds no executable workflow or dispatch and grants no ROOT authority. Local executable checks are prohibited until different entire source GO and NEW complete-input native/toolchain/ENV/IPC admission. Read-only natural CI is source evidence only. Existing production #1635 is separately owned. Native capabilities and off-host F7 transfer stay UNKNOWN/ABSENT respectively.

Freeze: exact source HEAD/tree/base, every raw tracked blob and physical size/hash, all changed/absent paths, external REPORT/MANIFEST readback, exact PR/provider/natural checks. Self-review must name incomplete implementation as incomplete. No source or safety acceptance may be inferred from a planned function, stub, documentary requirement, test label or retained fixture.
